messages:
sara-sales: Heads-up: fintech prospect asked for a concise POC success spec we can hand to their engineers and legal. Need measurable KPIs (latency/cost/quality), security must-haves, and a short ops handoff checklist. Can we agree by EOD? CC @devon-se @miguel-solutions @tina-security @oliver-sre @anna-csm @ken-finance @rachel-legal

devon-se: quick Q on traffic: are we expecting steady throughput or large demo spikes? affects whether we recommend hosted with pinned instances or a tiny dedicated pool.

anna-csm: their initial note: baseline 20 reqs/min, several scheduled batch demos that reach ~200 reqs/min for 10-20 minutes. POC requested for 3 weeks.

miguel-solutions: propose crisp acceptance gates:
- Quality: >= 92% business-rule pass rate on the curated eval set (200 prompts)
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for the demo prompt mix (synthetic), p99 <= 550ms as a safety check
- Cost: weekly token spend <= $1,500 (POC cap)
Also require automated smoke tests and a runbook for failover.

ken-finance: finance needs an explicit burn cap and an approval flow. We can set an auto-throttle at $1,500/wk and alert at 75% consumption. Any overage needs pre-approval.

tina-security: security asks (first pass):
- VPC peering or PrivateLink for API traffic
- Customer-managed KMS for any sensitive outputs stored
- SAML SSO for team access to Console
- No raw prompt retention in logs; PII redaction pipeline for inputs before storing
- 90-day audit log retention (events + hashed prompt IDs)
We'll need their completed SQA + DPA to finalize.

rachel-legal: I need the DPA draft and a short summary of what data we persist during the POC. If they request on-prem or air-gap, that's enterprise-only and will need legal review for the procurement path.

oliver-sre: ops notes: autoscale warmup + burst capacity are mandatory for 200 reqs/min spikes. Plan: pre-warm a small dedicated pool 10 minutes before scheduled demos, enable burst tokens, and a canary fallback to the higher-capacity model if p95 exceeds 300ms for >30s. I'll also add health checks for p95/p99 and token burn.

ops-bot: task queued  created ephemeral sandbox creds `poc-1872604321-sandbox` (8h). Endpoint + secure creds shared to the customer via vault link.

miguel-solutions: model plan: primary = quantized-fast-6B for low latency; fallback = 13B-hq for edge cases flagged by confidence. Routing rule: if model confidence < threshold OR business-rule fails, call fallback and log for audit. Also prepare a small prompt-tuning pass.

miguel-solutions: eval harness (example):
```
python eval_harness.py --endpoint https://sandbox.redwood.example --prompts set_200.json --model fast-6b --metrics pass_rate,latency --embed-threshold 0.80 --human-seed 50 --out results.csv
```
We use embedding cosine >= 0.80 for automated semantic-match and human review on 50 seeds.

anna-csm: proposed timeline:
- Week A: kickoff, security intake, DPA/DPA draft
- Week B: prompt freeze, sandbox access, baseline runs
- Week C: prompt tuning, reliability tests, dashboard setup
- Week D: final demo, acceptance, ops handoff & runbook delivery
Customer wants a demo at end of Week C.

miguel-solutions: blockers to call out: final SQA answers, signed DPA, agreement on the model pinning strategy (which model is primary), and whether the customer insists on VPC day-1.

sara-sales: action items:
- @tina-security: kick SQA review and flag any blockers by EOD tomorrow.
- @rachel-legal: prepare DPA + short data retention summary for customer.
- @devon-se + @oliver-sre: draft autoscale/pre-warm plan and canary policy.
- @miguel-solutions: ingest their 200 prompts and run baseline on fast-6B + 13B by Tue.
- @ken-finance: set POC burn cap in the quote and configure alerts at 75%.
- @anna-csm: lock demo slot and share schedule with customer.

ken-finance: will add the burn cap and alerting to the POC quote. Finance needs explicit approval path for any ad-hoc overages.

tina-security: acknowledged; I'll request the SQA and DPA contacts. If they demand on-prem deployment we move to Private offering path and loop Legal/Finance.

miguel-solutions: I'll post baseline numbers (pass rate + p95/p99 + token burn) once runs complete. If quality <92% we'll iterate prompt engineering and maybe toggle to a slightly larger primary.

anna-csm: noted  emailing customer the week-by-week plan now. Confirming demo date for the end of Week C.

sara-sales: Thanks team  let's reconvene after baseline results. Re-open thread when numbers are in.
